user.title: Share your heating
user.description:
Your home appears on the map as part of the 5 km square centred on {area}. Your exact location never leaves Home Assistant.

If your thermostat is always in heat or auto mode and turns the heating on and off by itself, choose **Actively heating**. Otherwise your home will always show as on.

data.heating_on_means: Show my heating as on when

entities.title: Choose your entities
entities.description: You'll need at least one thermostat and an outdoor temperature sensor.

data_description.climate_entity: Pick every zone if you have more than one. The heating counts as on if any of them is.
data_description.indoor_temperature_entity: Leave empty to use the average of your thermostats' readings.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: A sensor outside your home, or a weather integration's temperature. Its reading is shown as your area's outside temperature.
data_description.heating_active_entity: Anything that shows the boiler or heat pump is running: a boiler or heat hub sensor, a pump, a compressor, a flow sensor. On/off states and numbers both work. Leave empty to use whether your thermostats say they're calling for heat.
data_description.heating_active_above: For sensors that report a number, such as pump power or flow rate: count as active above this value. Defaults to 0.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the website. Try again in a few minutes.
error.no_hvac_action: Your thermostats don't say whether they're calling for heat. Pick a sensor that shows the heating is running.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This home is already sharing its heating.
abort.no_location: Set your home location in Settings, System, General first.
